rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=False, img_n_bf=6, img_kernel=9, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.05, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 manduca_bilateral breast (train_n=400, val=200). SIX-BOX from BEST (iter-4/7 img_sr=0.05 img_n_bf=6 hr~0.2755): (1) PRIOR: best hr=0.2758 (iter-7 ep30) ~= iter-4 0.2752 (ep10). img_n_bf SATURATED by 6; img_sr PEAK=0.05 (fully mapped); EPOCHS INERT (10->30 = +0.0006, 21-param bilateral converged by ep10). Image spatial footprint (img_kernel=5, img_sx=img_sy=0.5) UNTOUCHED. (2) FAILURE MODE: the image bilateral spatial reach is small -- kernel=5/sigma=0.5px pools only immediate neighbors, so coherent 128-view STREAKS (which extend across many pixels) aren't averaged out. Range bandwidth is tuned; the spatial kernel cannot reach the streak structure. (3) ONE KNOB: img_kernel 5 -> 9 (from iter-4 best; ep=10 kept -- proven equivalent to ep30, cheaper). Larger spatial support per filter. (4) HYPOTHESIS: img_kernel 5->9 lifts hr above 0.2758 because a wider spatial kernel lets each edge-preserving bilateral pool pixels further along the coherent streak direction, suppressing streak residual the 5-tap kernel can't reach; range sigma=0.05 keeps it edge-preserving. FALSIFIER: if hr flat/drops, spatial reach not binding (or sigma_spatial=0.5 caps effective reach) -> iter-9 raises img_sx/img_sy instead. (5) BUDGET: larger kernel = modestly more compute; ep10 base 236s -> est ~400s, under 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-9 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
